weaknesses.title: METH optional keyword steals var METHODINFO Handler METH
weaknesses.detail: METHODINFO accepts optional METH/METHOD/OF before method name. A string var named METH is consumed as keyword; next token missing → hard parse fail METHODINFO [JSON] Class|obj method (not soft miss).
weaknesses.repro: LET METH="process"; METHODINFO Handler METH → fail parse

weaknesses.title: HASMETHOD method name is raw token — no string-var resolve
weaknesses.detail: Unlike METHODINFO which looks up string vars for method name, HASMETHOD uses the ident text literally. LET m="process"; HASMETHOD Handler m looks for method "m" → 0. Dynamic ARG-driven has-method must use METHODINFO OK or string literals.
weaknesses.repro: LET m2="process"; HASMETHOD Handler m2 → LAST_N=0

weaknesses.title: No schema hash / version field for contract drift
weaknesses.detail: CLASSINFO exposes name/n_fields/n_methods/live/fields/methods but no stable digest. Agents cannot pin expected schema fingerprint across deploys without manual bag compare.
weaknesses.repro: gate_class only min counts not field-set equality

weaknesses.title: Arity only — no required/optional/default params
weaknesses.detail: NPARAMS is declared formals count. Cannot express defaults or rest args; SEND still hard-fails wrong arity at call time after gate.

weaknesses.title: CLASSINFO unknown soft OK=0 LAST blank
weaknesses.detail: Same soft pattern as METHODINFO; agents must check OK before reading NFIELDS.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: VAL/META/SCHEMA last line often no trailing $ under cat -A.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE softens
weaknesses.detail: REQUIRE=abc leaves NEED_HIT=0; miss paths exit 0.

weaknesses.title: Class arg is token not var; only method name resolves vars
weaknesses.detail: METHODINFO Handler MNAME resolves MNAME string; class side uses ident text (LAST special-cased). Cannot pass class name via arbitrary string var easily.
weaknesses.repro: METHODINFO LAST MNAME after setting LAST
